title: Router REPLAN dispatch under fleet mode must designate a worktree (or sanctioned scratch cwd)
problem: Half 2 of null-failreasons-capture (half 1 — seal-time FailReasons backfill — landed in PR #442). The one diagnosed null-reason mechanism: advisor/router REPLAN dispatch under fleet mode launched without a designated worktree and was correctly refused (cycle-1358 router-launch-error.txt). The refusal is now at least VISIBLE in FailReasons via the backfill; the dispatch itself remains broken. SECOND SIGHTING 2026-09-02, cycle-1601 (wave-20260902): the same refusal killed the post-FAIL disposition replan (routing-decision-7) — the agy router launch errored 'fleet mode: explicit worktree required (refusing process-cwd fallback)' in router-launch-error.txt. The refusal is CORRECT; the dispatch path is what must designate a cwd. Weight raised from 0.68 on the recurrence. This item absorbed the separately filed duplicate 'router-fleet-mode-worktree-refusal' rather than carrying two open records of one defect — the duplicate was filed because THIS item was invisible to the queue (its numeric priority field failed to unmarshal, so LoadDir dropped it) from 2026-08-11 until 2026-09-11.
fix: Designate the worktree on the replan dispatch path (the lane's own worktree when one exists) or fall back to a sanctioned scratch cwd for the router agent under fleet mode.
acceptance: A fleet-mode REPLAN dispatch launches with a designated cwd (no refusal); regression test over the router dispatch seam; wiring proof.
